title: Balanced Latin Rectangles: New Best-Known Values via Simple Local Search
description:
Best-known values for the balanced Latin rectangle problem (minimum imbalance of k×n Latin rectangles). A simple simulated-annealing search improves 33 of the 51 non-square instances with 8 ≤ n ≤ 13 from Voboril, Peruvemba Ramaswamy and Szeider (CP 2025) and matches the other 18. It beats each previous record after a median of 0.12 CPU seconds on one laptop core, and matches the four SAT results with reported solving times (32 minutes to 5.5 hours) from Peruvemba Ramaswamy and Szeider (CP 2023) in at most 0.07 seconds.

Contents: every best rectangle (results/rectangles), previous and new values (results/results.csv), raw solver output, timing runs, an independent exact-arithmetic checker that reproduces all eleven rectangles printed in the two prior papers, the C solver, scripts that reproduce every run, figures, and the LaTeX source and PDF of the accompanying paper.

The new values are upper bounds; optimality remains open for every improved instance.
